Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tairakuri-konnyaku-2/

A tour to see, hear, and taste the seasons of the Agano area's rural mountains. Konnyaku yams take about 3 years to grow. Learn to make konnyaku using traditional cooking methods. You can take home the konnyaku you make yourself.

【Fee】Adults ¥4,000 | Elementary school students ¥3,000 | Preschoolers ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, lunch, etc.)

【Capacity】3 groups (up to 4 people per group)

【Guide】Taira Chestnut Orchard (Tairakuri-en) staff

【What to bring】Drink, apron, head scarf, towel, face mask

【Note】Taira Chestnut Orchard website: https://tairakurien.com/
location: 集合 たいら栗園（西武池袋線「東吾野駅」下車徒歩15分）
summary: Experience the rural mountain landscape with all five senses – make homemade konnyaku (devil's tongue)!!!
